svg.title: Central autoscaling for independent vClusters
svg.desc: One Agent/KEDA/KPA installation runs in the main AKS cluster. Ordinary ScaledObjects, ScaledJobs, authentication resources and workloads belong to each vCluster. KPA reads CPU samples through vc-1's metrics API. Central KEDA reads the private Redis signal, and the controllers update only the corresponding member API. vc-3 is created during the demo. Redis runs behind a private internal load balancer in a second AKS cluster on the same virtual network.

g.text: SO/SJ and authentication resources stay inside each vCluster; tenant KEDA/KPA controllers are not installed.
